spot:bitter-springs.reason: Bitter Springs pool among pandanus and palms, 2016 colour, CC BY 2.0, categorised Elsey NP/Mataranka; the spring itself, distinct from the Mataranka Thermal Pools concrete-edged pool and the Roper River photo for Elsey; 2304 px.

spot:elsey-national-park.file: River in Mataranka, Northern Territory, Australia (3).jpg
spot:elsey-national-park.reason: Green Roper River reach in Elsey NP (categories Elsey National Park, Roper River), 2014 colour, CC BY-SA 4.0, 3264 px. Shows the park's river, a different subject from Bitter Springs and Mataranka Thermal Pools. Modest photo (palm trunk through the middle) but the river reads clearly.

spot:giwining-nature-park.reason: Tufa cascade on the Flora River, Tourism NT official photo from the Giwining Nature Park page (permission not confirmed); colour digital photo, 2592 px; the park's signature tufa falls, clear at thumbnail size.

spot:gregorys-tree.reason: The marked boab (carved date visible) behind its viewing platform and signs, Tourism NT official photo, 4002 px; the named tree itself, centred.

spot:judbarra-gregory-national-park.reason: Victoria River and red sandstone escarpments in golden light, Tourism NT/ATDW photo from the park page, 4928 px. Note: the Escarpment Walk spot (no valid photo yet, currently a Cotswolds file) must not later be given this same view.

spot:keep-river-national-park.reason: Beehive sandstone domes on the Goorrandalng walk, geotag -15.87,129.05 inside Keep River NP, categorised Keep River National Park, 2019, CC BY 2.0, 5702 px; centre crop holds the rock formations.

spot:limmen-national-park.reason: Southern Lost City sandstone pillar in Limmen NP (category Limmen National Park), 2017, CC BY 2.0, 4705 px; Southern Lost City is not a separate spot.

spot:devils-marbles.file: Karlu Karlu Rocks in Devils Marbles Conservation Reserve, NT.jpg
spot:devils-marbles.reason: The split granite marble with boulders behind, geotag at the reserve, 2017 WLE upload, CC BY-SA 4.0, 6000 px; instantly recognisable.

spot:iytwelepenty-davenport-range-nation.file: P4150010 Old Police Station Waterhole - Iytwelepenty - Davenport Ranges National Park.jpg
spot:iytwelepenty-davenport-range-nation.reason: Old Police Station Waterhole, the park's main visitor site, geotagged in the park, 2021, CC BY-SA 4.0, 4000 px. Upper third is plain sky, so zoom slightly.

spot:barrow-creek-telegraph-station.reason: The stone telegraph station with its sign under the red hill, 2014, CC BY 2.0, 4000 px. Building is right of centre with highway and sky taking much of the frame, so zoom onto it.

spot:newcastle-waters.reason: Jones Store, the preserved centrepiece of the Newcastle Waters ghost town named in the bio, Tourism NT official photo, 3456 px; Jones Store is not a separate spot.

spot:garig-gunak-barlu-national-park.reason: Flickr 'White Sands of Cobourg Peninsula' by kiwinz, taken 2008-05-16, licence verified CC BY 2.0 on the Flickr page; the whole Cobourg Peninsula is the park. 1000 px (just over the 960 floor). A plain beach view, but it is the park's coast; lower half is foreground sand, so zoom a little.
